prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Stufenplatz", a wide public square in the middle ring of the city, one level above the slums: cleaner, brighter, smooth grey concrete and pale stone tiles instead of cobblestones, chrome railings, glass, a few planted trees in round concrete tubs, holographic advertising light. The large walkable area is the whole center of the image: a shallow amphitheater of wide flat concrete steps (each step a broad, clearly walkable terrace, drawn as gentle horizontal bands) curving around a stage in the upper middle.
CENTER, slightly above the middle: the most eye-catching spot - a low square TV stage platform with a huge glowing outdoor video screen on a steel frame behind it (abstract colourful picture only, no text), stage spotlights, and next to the stage on its right a tall black camera crane arm reaching over the stage.
TOP LEFT, on the upper building row: a modern glass TV studio building with big tinted windows, a glowing round satellite-dish emblem on the roof (a symbol, no letters), a glass double door at its foot facing the square.
TOP CENTER: a sleek arch of white stone and glass leading into a shopping arcade, in front of it a row of three chrome turnstile gates with small green and red lamps.
TOP RIGHT: the plain grey back side of a delicatessen with a roller-shutter loading door, a small white delivery van parked beside it, stacked crates of bottles.
RIGHT UPPER EDGE: a slim elevated pedestrian bridge of white steel and glass railings that starts as a ramp on the right side of the square and climbs diagonally up toward the top-right corner, where it ends at a viewing platform with a coin telescope; a hazy skyline of glowing white corporate towers beyond.
LEFT EDGE: a small hair salon storefront with a striped awning, a barber pole and a mirror visible through the window.
BOTTOM RIGHT on the square: a food truck selling giant pretzels, with a giant pretzel shape on its roof (a symbol), a few bistro tables; near the middle-left of the steps a wooden crate used as a street preacher's soapbox, with an old broken radio on it.
BOTTOM LEFT: an entrance stairwell going down into a metro station, with a glowing cyan railing and a round metro emblem (no letters).
Small things at the edges: litter bins, a cleaning robot parked at a wall, pigeons' perches on lamp posts (no birds), slim street lamps, thin cables drawn thin so they don't hide the floor.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: BOTTOM edge (south) center - a wide grand staircase leading down out of the image toward the old train station; LEFT edge (west) - the square continues as a broad street between iron-grey government buildings toward a courthouse; TOP edge (north) center - the turnstile arch into the glass arcade; RIGHT edge (east) - a tall construction-site fence of corrugated panels covered with big poster boards (pictures of a futuristic park, no text), barbed wire on top.
Time: evening dusk, neon and holograms just switched on, dry ground with soft reflections.
